lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in approximately five horizontal rows starting posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a regular geometric grid across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid where blobs are positioned at the nodes of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light top edges to shadowed lower recesses.
